params.label: View
params.help: Dark: eyes peering out of the dark. Loose: whole eyeballs in a cluster. Macro: one eye close up.

params.label: Colours
params.help: Natural: real eye colours under white light. Palette: the irises in the palette's colours. Palette light: natural eyes lit and reflecting the palette's colours.

params.label: Stare
params.help: How often a new look is straight at you.

params.label: Darting
params.help: How often a sharp sound makes the gaze jump.

params.label: Blinks
params.help: The share of the eyes that blink on each beat.

params.label: Pupils
params.help: How much the bass widens the pupils (a little late, as real pupils are).

params.label: Wet
params.help: How much the tear film shines.
